blurb: iFlyTOTO operates from Porter FBO at Billy Bishop Airport in Toronto, providing exclusive flight packages aboard Navajo P31 and Cessna 172 aircraft. Guests experience aerial tours of Toronto, Niagara Falls, and other premier destinations. The company offers group and private flights with durations ranging from 45 minutes to 6 hours.

quotes.text: From the lounge at Buttonville Airport to the awe-inspiring views of the Toronto landscape and Niagra Falls from above, this experience was nothing short of spectacular! The limousine service was top-notch, and the winery tour near Niagara Falls was an unforgettable experience. The five-hour adventure was fun, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an upscale and memorable day trip. PS: Shoutout to our pilots, Alex and Dannis. Both were courteous and were the best at what they did.

We did the one hour tour of Toronto and Niagara with Iflytoto. Do this if you’re not from Canada you’ll get all the views you need. We moved to a private flight and it turned out to be the best thing we experience while being in Toronto especially for the younger kids if they enjoy flying. The pilots are great and make the flight feel as safe as possible… FYI the pilots appreciate the tips!! Overall best sightseeing in Toronto.

Great flight for my moms bday surprise, aircraft was very enjoyable being in the front with the pilot. They even provided us with champagne on the private flight. All in all 10/10 experience with the staff communication and the experience itself. Highly recommend upgrading to private, it was worth the cost even though it was a smaller plane.

Wonderful experience! Wish I could give more than 5 ratings. Staff was very supportive and accommodative inspite of us being late by 10mins. Our pilot- Arty was very friendly, patient and kept a good check on our comfort during the flight. Truly a memorable experience, totally worth it!
It was my first time on a smaller plane I loved the experience. The second we landed, I knew for sure that I wanted to do this for a living. The experience increased my love for aviation even more.
It was an incredible experience I thank the Iflytoto team for their professionalism their pilot was super nice and knowledgeable. It’s a must do and will be going to other destinations with them.
